title: Survive a mid-run access token expiry during an SDDC LCM fleet depot sync
prompt:
Implement the exported `Invoke-VcfSddcLcmDepotSync` function in `src/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync.psm1`. It registers a Fleet Depot with the VCF 9.1 SDDC LCM service, reads that registration task's completed status, and resolves component versions to binary URLs. Before implementing, research the SDDC Manager `createToken` and `refreshAccessToken` operations, their generated VMware VCF PowerCLI 9.1 bindings, and the SDDC LCM `setDepot`, `getTask`, and `resolveDepotComponents` operations in official VMware sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. The environment provides `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager` 13.5.0.25380678 and its dependencies. Do not install, copy, or redefine VMware commands.

Use `Initialize-VcfTokenCreationSpec` with `Invoke-VcfCreateToken` for `createToken`, and `Invoke-VcfRefreshAccessToken` for `refreshAccessToken`. Drive the SDDC LCM operations directly over REST: `POST /v1/depot` for `setDepot`, bodyless `GET /v1/tasks/{taskId}` for the SDDC LCM `getTask`, and `POST /v1/depot/components` for `resolveDepotComponents`. Do not substitute the different SDDC Manager `getTask` operation.

The caller owns the connected `VcfSddcManagerServer` that is passed in. Do not connect, disconnect, or otherwise mutate it. Mint one token pair from the supplied credential, then issue one logical `setDepot` operation, one logical `getTask` operation for the ID that `setDepot` returned, and one logical `resolveDepotComponents` operation, in that order. Require that single `getTask` result to have status `SUCCEEDED`. The one request that receives HTTP 401 is retried as described below and is still the same logical operation. Return one object carrying `TaskId`, `TaskStatus`, `ResolvedComponents`, and `AccessTokenRefreshCount`.

The access token stops being accepted part way through the run and the service answers HTTP 401. Recover without losing work: refresh the access token exactly once through the SDK binding and replay only the unauthorized request, byte for byte, with the refreshed bearer token. Work the service already accepted must never be reissued, and a second token pair must never be minted to paper over the expiry.

Every unset optional member must be absent on the wire rather than sent empty: `TokenCreationSpec` must carry only `username` and `password`, `DepotComponentsSpec` must omit its top-level `version` when the caller supplies none, and a `ComponentVersion` entry with no version key must serialize to exactly `{"component":"..."}` rather than a null or empty version. `X-Correlation-Id` is defined only on `setDepot`, so it must not appear on any other request. None of these operations has a query parameter.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Verification checks the exact operation order, raw targets, headers, JSON bodies, bare JSON string refresh body, byte-for-byte replay, and omission of every unset optional member. Edit only `src/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync.psm1`.
